projects.name: Airlock
projects.blurb: Catch passing tasks, sort them later — a tiny capture surface plus an Eisenhower matrix that syncs across web, phone, and Windows.

projects.name: BUS SUB
projects.blurb: A substitute driver, a broken-down school bus and a five-minute deadline. Keep the kids calm, stay hydrated without overdoing it, and get everyone back to school.
projects.stack: Vanilla JS · Canvas 2D pseudo-3D · HTML5 Audio

projects.name: Night Shift
projects.blurb: A turn-based solo survival-horror crawl where every action shows its odds before you commit and a failed roll ends your turn. Four scenarios, seeded maps you can replay.

projects.name: FIELD
projects.blurb: Third-person survival horror around an overturned cop car in a snowy field at night. Fix the radio, call for help, and hold the dark back with a flashlight, a pistol and a few flares until the rescue arrives.

projects.name: Ads agent
projects.blurb: Warehouse-native paid search platform: Google and Microsoft Ads in one view, automatic ad-group and keyword flagging, AI recommendations with outcome tracking, and change notes that write their own follow-up read-outs.

projects.name: Enrollment analytics
projects.blurb: Enrollment, retention, and pipeline analysis for a private school, delivered to its board of trustees.

projects.name: KINOLUST
projects.blurb: A DJ-style curation tool for film watch parties — browse a 5,000-film library by genre, director and TMDB keyword, build a set, and play it through mpv to friends on a Discord screenshare.
projects.stack: Node.js · Express · SQLite · mpv · TMDB API

projects.name: Ghost Signal
projects.blurb: Co-op rescue game: one crew is stranded, the other is searching, and the only channel between them is the interface.

projects.name: Stemma
projects.blurb: A community-maintained catalog of cannabis strain lineage. Search a strain to see its parents, ancestors, origin and sources, with timeline and map views.
projects.stack: Python build · Vanilla JS · Leaflet · GitHub Pages

projects.name: Primer
projects.blurb: Ask for a primer on anything and get the same shape back every time — context, key events, live debates with citations, and where to read next.
